analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 59.7 continues in neutral range, MACD histogram shows weak improvement. After 5 consecutive daily closes in the red, attempts to rebound failed to break the $0.26 resistance. Price dipped below the $0.23 support of the 20-day moving average and is now attempting to rise again. With volatility ATR at 5.49%, a stop loss of 1.3x ATR is $0.013, and a target of 2.6x ATR is $0.026. Risk/reward ratio is 1.92. For a buy entry, set at $0.24, stop loss at $0.227, and take profit at $0.26.
